title: Senior Machine Learning Platform Engineer
description: Helix Imaging builds cloud ML infrastructure for regulated medical-imaging products. We are hiring a Senior Machine Learning Platform Engineer to own our model training and deployment platform on AWS. You will design scalable training and inference infrastructure (S3, EC2, Lambda), build CI/CD for model delivery, stand up production monitoring and automated recovery, and reduce model deployment cycle time. Strong plus: experience with distributed training, PyTorch, Slurm or similar schedulers, Docker, and working in an FDA 510(k) / ISO 13485 regulated environment with DICOM/PACS and PHI handling. You will mentor junior engineers and partner with clinical deployment teams. We value engineers who can cut deployment time, raise reliability, and keep infrastructure auditable.
